items.stemEn: On a ____ of one to ten, how much do you like this movie?
items.stemZh: 如果用一到十分來打分數，你有多喜歡這部電影？

items.passageEn: My cousin is studying for a degree in science. Last month, she studied the weather for a school report. Every day, she checked the temperature. The average temperature in July was thirty degrees, and the range was from twenty-five to thirty-six. She also counted the rainy days: there were only three. The report took a long time, so her teacher gave her an additional week to finish.
items.passageZh: 我表姊正在攻讀科學學位。上個月，她為了學校報告研究天氣。她每天都記錄氣溫。七月的平均氣溫是三十度，範圍從二十五度到三十六度。她也數了下雨的天數：只有三天。這份報告花了很多時間，所以老師多給了她一週完成。

questions.questionZh: 七月的平均氣溫是幾度？

referenceEn: There is an additional fee for breakfast.
You have to pay an additional fee for breakfast.

items.promptZh: 這班公車一小時只來兩次。
referenceEn: This bus only comes twice an hour.
The bus comes only twice an hour.
rubricZh: 用 twice 表示「兩次」（例如 twice an hour）
only 可放在動詞前或 twice 前（例如 only comes、comes only 等）
主詞是單數，動詞加 s（例如 comes）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：The oven must be at two hundred degrees 不太道地，常說 The oven should be at / Set the oven to two hundred degrees（疑似）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Set the oven to two hundred degrees."（原 "The oven must be at two hundred degrees."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "把烤箱設定在兩百度。"（原 "烤箱要到兩百度才行。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：雨量研究「用秤秤雨水重量」(used a scale to weigh rain water) 不合常理，雨量一般量體積／高度；情境牽強。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "My cousin is studying for a degree in science. Last month, she studied the weather for a school report. Every day, she checked the temperature. The average temperature in July was thirty degrees, and the range was from twenty-five to thirty-six. She also counted the rainy days: there were only three. Her teacher gave her an additional week to finish."（原 "My cousin is studying for a degree in science. Last month, she studied the weather for a school report. Every day, she counted the sunny days and checked the temperature. The average temperature in July was thirty degrees, and the range was from twenty-five to thirty-six. She also used a scale to weigh rain water. Her teacher gave her an additional week to finish."）；「用秤秤雨水」改為數下雨的天數（count 為本課字；scale 另有 mcq 正解與單字卡）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯配合英文修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "我表姊正在攻讀科學學位。上個月，她為了學校報告研究天氣。她每天都記錄氣溫。七月的平均氣溫是三十度，範圍從二十五度到三十六度。她也數了下雨的天數：只有三天。老師多給了她一週的時間完成報告。"（原 "我表姊正在攻讀科學學位。上個月，她為了學校報告研究天氣。她每天數晴天的天數，也記錄氣溫。七月的平均氣溫是三十度，範圍從二十五度到三十六度。她還用秤來秤雨水的重量。老師多給了她一週的時間完成報告。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：題目要說「你」一天或一週做兩次的事，參考答案 My mother calls my grandmother twice a day. 主詞是別人，不符題目指定對象。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "I call my grandmother twice a day."（原 "My mother calls my grandmother twice a day."）
